Today would have been #EricaGarner's birthday, if the grief didn't kill her. I wish I could I tell her that things are different, that the world has changed. I wish I could, but I can't.

#BlackLivesMatter. Still. Always.

Happy birthday in Heaven, Erica. We miss you down here.
